The '''Flyntaria system''' was located in the [[D'Astan sector/Legends|D'Astan sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="NewTerritories" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of<ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Flyntarian tabac stick]]|system=Flyntaria [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref> [[Flyntarian tabac stick]]s.<ref name="AIR">{{WEGCite|story=An Offer They Couldn't Refuse|book=Alliance Intelligence Reports}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Flyntaria [[Star system/Legends|system]] was mentioned in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square O-6.<ref name="EAOC" />
